questions.key_step: Treat x as the dependent variable; linear DE with I.F. e^y, then parts.
questions.justification: Routine linear DE with a parts integral (L2); no anchor this low in Advanced.

questions.key_step: Complete squares to find the axes, then integrate (6-x^2) from -2 to sqrt6.
questions.justification: Standard conic + area chain of three routine steps (L2).

questions.key_step: Linear DE in x with I.F. e^{-1/y} and a hidden parts integral.
questions.justification: Linear DE plus a substitution and parts, with a fiddly initial-condition step (L3).

questions.key_step: Bernoulli n=2: z=-1/y, linear DE, then a point from the line.
questions.justification: Standard Bernoulli reduction, several routine steps (L2).

questions.key_step: Rewrite as e[x]e^{-{x}}; periodic integral times sum 0..9.
questions.justification: Familiar floor/fractional-part periodicity trick, chained with a sum (L2).
Short second-derivative test via FTC (L2).

questions.key_step: Spot d(xy), separate variables, track the sign branch of 1-xy.
questions.justification: Non-obvious exact differential plus sign/branch care (L3).

questions.key_step: t=e^y gives a linear DE.
questions.justification: Single standard substitution then linear DE (L2).

questions.key_step: Spot t=x ln x as derivative of the bracket, then linear DE.
questions.justification: Substitution less visible than usual, then routine linear DE (L3).

questions.key_step: Find [x]+[sin x] on each sub-interval and sum.
questions.justification: Several floor breakpoints must all be right (L3), like other greatest-integer integrals.

questions.key_step: Integral is least when [a,b] covers the region where integrand is negative.
questions.justification: One familiar idea, applied once (L1).

questions.key_step: Period 1 and [sin 2 pi x] = 0 or -1 on the halves of a period.
questions.justification: Periodicity plus careful floor evaluation (L3).

questions.key_step: Rationalise, split x=(x+alpha)-alpha and integrate; solve alpha^{3/2}.
questions.justification: Routine multi-step integration with surds (L2).

questions.key_step: Two successive substitutions (t=2x-1, u^2=t^2+5).
questions.justification: Standard substitution chain (L2).

questions.key_step: e^{k log a}=a^k and f'/f.
questions.justification: Single simplification trick (L1).

questions.key_step: Take x^6 out of the bracket and put 1+x^{-6}=t^3.
questions.justification: Non-obvious substitution for binomial differential (L3).

questions.key_step: Shift origin X=x-2, Y=y+4, linear DE.
questions.justification: Shift plus linear DE, routine chain (L2).

questions.key_step: Solve to a circle, area fixes a, then normals through the centre.
questions.justification: Three linked ideas (DE, circle area, normals) (L3).

questions.key_step: {x} has period 1.
questions.justification: One familiar periodicity move (L1).

questions.key_step: Divide by x^14 so the numerator is -dt over t^2.
questions.justification: Hidden substitution on a high-degree rational function (L3).
